reason: After the patch, `parseRefreshTokenResponse` throws `Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` on a failed parse (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts:21-23), so the `prisma.credential.update` at packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:265 is never reached on parse failure. Persisting stale credentials after a failed `safeParse` was the pre-patch behaviour, which this patch removed.
